summary: Verified the bug fix: campaign Start/Stop is now an explicit Button (data-testid=campaign-toggle-{id}) instead of a Switch. Created throwaway 'QA_START_TEST' campaign targeting only '@qa_nonexistent_grp_zzz999' (so no real group is messaged), exercised Start -> Stop -> Delete end-to-end while the real user campaign was left completely untouched. All 4 network calls returned 200 (POST /api/campaigns, POST /campaigns/{id}/start, POST /campaigns/{id}/stop, DELETE /campaigns/{id}). UI reflected running/stopped states correctly, success toast 'Campaign started — broadcasting now' appeared. Button is plainly clickable — the previous Switch-not-clickable issue is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: CampaignList.toggle() reads both c.running and c.status==='running' which is defensive and correct, but backend consistency should be verified — pick one canonical field to reduce ambiguity.

review_request mentions the real user campaign is named 'summary', but the currently seeded live user campaign in the DB is named 'testing' (97 targets, stopped). Not a bug in the fix, just a note for main agent that context drifted.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted transient 'QA_START_TEST' campaign via UI targeting nonexistent handle only. No real groups messaged. Real 'testing' campaign was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Start/Stop toggle button works. Selectors: campaign-toggle-{id}, campaign-status-{id}, campaign-delete-{id}, campaign-card-{id}, campaign-create-open, campaign-name-input, msgtype-text|media|forward, campaign-text-input, campaign-groups-input, campaign-interval-input, campaign-submit-button, nav-campaigns.
